data.body:
Resolved as duplicate — the split this story asks for already landed on main.

Analysis (2026-08-21): the premise (pass1.py at the 800 LOC cap) no longer holds. Commit d6ad2953dd ('Split plan_review pass1 container stage out', Gerrit change 1752, MERGED with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, rebar-ticket 5e53-234f-5c65-477d / cinderlike-lucky-akitainu Change 1) performed exactly this refactor:

- Seam: run_pass1's lone 'if container and ctx.has_children:' branch — the container (G3/G4) pairing stage cluster (CONTAINER_CRITERIA, _CONTAINER_MAX_WORKERS, _too_big_finding, build_sibling_roster, _timed_pairing, _run_container) extracted to container_stage.py; _submit_ctx moved to generation.py to keep the import direction one-way (pass1 -> container_stage -> generation).
- LOC after: pass1.py 534, container_stage.py 301, generation.py 368 — all within the 200-500 target band (pass1 with ~266 lines of real headroom under the locked 800 cap), no file under 100 LOC.
- Verified on current origin/main: module-size gate limit 800 satisfied; complexity ratchet 'active=48 new=0 increased=0 stale=1' (no new or increased entries); pass1.py re-exports every moved name so all import/patch sites are unchanged and plan-review tests passed unmodified (change merged with Verified +1).

All acceptance criteria of this story are therefore already met by the merged change. Closing --class=duplicate against cinderlike-lucky-akitainu; the typing-ratchet epic acute-agitable-xiphosuran (003c-2dd2) is unblocked — pass1.py now has headroom for annotations.
